newsitem.title: USA: Rexene dissidents see record date as rigged. [CORRECTED 20:08 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Rexene dissidents see record date as rigged. [CORRECTED 20:08 GMT]

text.p: Guy Wyser-Pratte, president of Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc, along with a managing director Fred Kambitz at Spear, Leeds & Kellogg, said Friday that they had urged Rexene Corp to change the record date for its special shareholders meeting to April 30, from April 18.

In a letter to Rexene's board, Wyser-Pratte charged that by setting the record date of the meeting on April 18, the company was seeking to minimize the number of shareholders in attendance. (Corrects to reflect that Rexene did not change the date of the meeting)
Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds are attempting to elect a slate of directors to Rexene's board, in oppositon to management, and its group holds 10.1 percent of Rexene stock.
They said in their letter that they were awaiting a response no later than March 12.
